runs.name: checkpointed-fraction-250k
runs.notes: The file's new defaults, and its whole sampling parameterization: a step keeps 1% to 90% of what the reconstructor predicted, from 2 to 12 context views, held under 300,000 Gaussians. Twice the ceiling and twice the views of the best run before it, which is what recomputing the backbone's blocks in the backward pass pays for. Output heads left as the checkpoint has them.
